summary: Root v0.1.2 meets P5's outcome: the validation Job runs in kube-coder-modern-app-toolchain:node-24 with a /work emptyDir, the lockfile lookup and pre-baked-browser claims are gone, the docs and changelog are updated, and the tag is on origin; nothing the apps' suites need is missing from the image. One advisory finding: the Job's tar extraction into the root-owned emptyDir prints errors and exits 2, which the script ignores.

findings.summary: tar xzf into the root:root 0777 /work emptyDir fails on the ./ entry (utime/chmod EPERM, exit 2) on every run; ignored by the script, so it is log noise only
